title: Root powers commute with the coefficient prefix of a coordinate presentation
statement: In the finite setting [def-pur-conventions] use the explicit ordered coefficients, pullback comparisons and descents of [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions]. Let B be finite type over k, f:U→B a compactifiable quasi-compact map with coordinates cU:U≅X_d(B) over B. Let r≤r' and both ell-powers annihilate A. Supply root-power maps q on U and qB on B, normalized by composition with the monic inclusions into G_m, and isomorphisms e,eB of the scalar-extended Tate lines with the pure-generator power-map formula. Set c,c' to the two ordered tower coefficient descents and k=c'.hom followed by pullback of the factorwise shifted tensor comparison eB and c.inv. Set prefix (respectively prefix') to inverse base-coefficient pullback for f, followed by pullback-composition for cU and the projection, followed by pullback along cU of c.inv (respectively c'.inv). Then the factorwise comparison induced by e followed by prefix equals prefix' followed by pullback of k. This is only a coefficient equation: it contains no trace, integration or exceptional inverse image.

source.place: Agreement on the model: ordered projective-line-normalized integration; annihilator independence clause of the orientation refinement

proof.text: The kernel inclusion equations identify q and qB with root-power maps. Restriction of units preserves powers, so their inverse-image square commutes. The pure-generator equations identify e,eB with the scalar-extended root-power maps. Use normalized finite Tate inverse image from [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]; since pure generators generate after sheafification, its square commutes with e,eB.

Induct on d in the explicit coefficient tensors of [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions]. At zero the comparison is identity and constant-unit inverse image is natural. At a successor tensor the induction square with the shifted line square. Tensor inverse-image comparison is natural in its two variables; shift and the degree-zero embedding preserve the equation.

Transport that square by the inverse-image composition comparison for cU followed by p. Its naturality gives the same equality with the coefficient descents appended. Expand k and cancel the adjacent c,c inverse pairs, using functoriality. This yields the displayed prefix equation, including the identity tensor at d=0 and the empty scheme.

theorem affineDiagonalPower_coefficient (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {U B : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : U ⟶ B) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    (r r' : ℕ) (hrr : r ≤ r')
    (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : P.Coefficient) = 0)
    (hA' : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1) : ℕ) : P.Coefficient) = 0)
    (cU : U ≅ affineTraceTower B d) (hcU : cU.hom ≫ affineTraceProjection B d = f)
    (q : U.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) ⟶
      U.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)))
    (e : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine U (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) P.Coefficient hA' ≅
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine U (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) P.Coefficient hA)
    (hq : q ≫ kernel.ι ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) • 𝟙 U.gmSheaf) =
      (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1) / P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) •
        kernel.ι ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) • 𝟙 U.gmSheaf))
    (he : ∀ (V : U.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : P.Coefficient)
      (z : (U.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1))).obj.obj V),
      e.hom.hom.app V (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator P.Coefficient
        (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) U hA' V a z) =
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator P.Coefficient
        (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) U hA V a (q.hom.app V z))
    (qB : B.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) ⟶
      B.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)))
    (eB : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine B (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) P.Coefficient hA' ≅
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine B (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) P.Coefficient hA)
    (hqB : qB ≫ kernel.ι ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) • 𝟙 B.gmSheaf) =
      (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1) / P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) •
        kernel.ι ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) • 𝟙 B.gmSheaf))
    (heB : ∀ (V : B.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : P.Coefficient)
      (z : (B.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1))).obj.obj V),
      eB.hom.hom.app V (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator P.Coefficient
        (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) B hA' V a z) =
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator P.Coefficient
        (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) B hA V a (qB.hom.app V z)) :
    letI := P.noetherian aB
    let N := P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)
    let N' := P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)
    let hN := pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos (r + 1)
    let hN' := pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos (r' + 1)
    let t := Etale.ambientAffineTraceTransport N hN P.Coefficient hA
    let t' := Etale.ambientAffineTraceTransport N' hN' P.Coefficient hA'
    let hB := WeilConjectures.PurityConventions.coefficientPower_isUnit P B aB r
    let hB' := WeilConjectures.PurityConventions.coefficientPower_isUnit P B aB r'
    let p := affineTraceProjection B d
    let F := Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient p
    let c := Etale.affineLinearCoefficientDescent P.Coefficient N hA t B hB d
    let c' := Etale.affineLinearCoefficientDescent P.Coefficient N' hA' t' B hB' d
    let k := c'.hom ≫ F.map (P.affineDiagonalPowerComparison B r r' hA hA' eB d).hom ≫ c.inv
    let E := Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient cU.hom
    let preMap := (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback
        P.Coefficient N hA t f hB d).inv ≫
      (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
        cU.hom p f hcU.symm).hom.app
          (Etale.affineLinearBaseCoefficient P.Coefficient N hA B d) ≫ E.map c.inv
    let preMapNext := (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback
        P.Coefficient N' hA' t' f hB' d).inv ≫
      (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
        cU.hom p f hcU.symm).hom.app
          (Etale.affineLinearBaseCoefficient P.Coefficient N' hA' B d) ≫ E.map c'.inv
    (P.affineDiagonalPowerComparison U r r' hA hA' e d).hom ≫ preMap =
      preMapNext ≫ E.map k
